verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a public REST API with an API reference overview, API key generation and role assignment, a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec for generating clients, and a dated API changelog with endpoint-level breaking changes; incidents can be created programmatically via the API. The probe's 404s at docs-hosted OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, because the spec is linked from rootly.com/swagger instead. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API, and a spec URL directly fetchable by non-browser clients (it returns 403).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries.
Track the latest changes, deprecations, and breaking updates to the Rootly API, including new endpoints, payload changes, and version release notes
To generate a new API key, navigate to: **Organization dropdown** > **Organization Settings** > **API Keys > Generate New API Key**.
The Rootly API allows you to create incidents automatically from monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, internal services, or any external automation system.
